{{Quote|What's the good of overthrowing tyrants&hellip;if we become tyrants ourselves in doing it? Don't you see? How we do things is just as important as what we do.|Niru, speaking to her faction|<ref name="Meow" />}}
'''Niru''' was a [[Cantrosian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and leader of a [[Niru's faction|faction]] loyal to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] based on a [[Niru's base|planet]] in the [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Niru and her followers were involved in a destructive conflict with a [[Minka's faction|rival group]] they thought were loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the fighting, Niru and her faction captured [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Rebel heroes]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and fellow Cantrosian [[Sami (Cantrosian)|Sami]], believing them to be Imperial agents. After a brief [[Skirmish in the Cantros system|altercation]], Niru was made aware that one of her faction's members, [[Durne]], had been manipulating events and setting both groups against each other. After Durne was detained, Niru and her team recognized their Rebel heroes and made amends with those she had taken to be the enemy.

==Biography==
===Tension in the Cantros system===
{{Quote|It will take more than a sorcerer's tricks to save you, now that we've caught you!|Niru apprehending Sami, Han Solo, and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Meow" />}}
[[File:NiruSwipesRight.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Niru (right) dissuading her followers from engaging in torture]]
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">"[[The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs]]" describes the events in the [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]] as occurring several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the [[Cantrosian]]<ref name="CN2" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] Niru was the leader of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&ndash;aligned [[Niru's faction|faction]] based on a [[Niru's base|planet]] in the [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]]<ref name="Meow" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Cantros system/Legends|Cantros system]]</ref> Several [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] from Niru's faction intercepted a flight of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] from what Niru and her comrades believed to be a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&ndash;aligned Cantrosian [[Minka's faction|faction]] near<ref name="Meow" /> the nearby [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] and shot them down. However, one pilot, [[Minka]], survived a crash landing on Saijo, and was rescued by [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Rebel heroes]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Meow" />

Minka&mdash;herself a Rebel sympathizer&mdash;believed the rival group to be Imperial agents themselves, leaving Organa, Skywalker, and Solo confused. Keen to investigate, the assemblage collected Minka's companion [[Sami (Cantrosian)|Sami]] and traveled to Niru's base aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]; en route, the ''Falcon'' was attacked by more of Niru's [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and crash-landed in a gully on the planet. After Minka and Organa were [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifted]] to safety by Skywalker with help from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Niru and several of her followers ambushed and captured Sami, Skywalker, and Solo. The three were taken to a nearby cave and restrained with [[Vine/Legends|vines]].<ref name="Meow" />

===The truth, revealed===
{{Quote|Did you see what weapon he used&mdash;? A lightsaber! And he wields it like a master!|Niru after seeing Luke Skywalker save her life|<ref name="Meow" />}}
[[File:NiruSpeech.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Niru (center right) appealing for sanity]]
Although several members of the faction were in favor of [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] their captives, Niru stopped any attempts to do so and attempted to reason with her comrades, telling them that such measures clashed with their moral obligation as Rebels. However, [[Durne]], a Cantrosian<ref name="Meow" /> who had been hired by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Ozrei N'takkilomandrife|Knife]] to sow disruption in the Cantros [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="NnT">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/nagai11202009/index.html|text=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs|int=The Forgotten War: The Nagai and the Tofs}}</ref> tried to persuade Niru that the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were indeed Imperial agents and to endorse [[Death/Legends|killing]] them. Sami and Solo, having overheard the exchange&mdash;and recognizing Durne as a prominent member of Minka's own faction&mdash;called out his double-dealing.<ref name="Meow" />

Touched by their words, Niru nonetheless ordered her comrades to [[Skirmish in the Cantros system|open fire]] as Minka and Organa arrived on the scene, unwilling to suspend her belief that an Imperial ambush was in progress. As the fighting intensified, Niru once more appealed for level heads to prevail; however, she was targeted by Durne, who attempted to use the crossfire as a chance to surreptitiously kill Niru with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot and regain control of the situation. Igniting his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Skywalker intercepted the shot and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|reflected]] it back at Durne, momentarily incapacitating the double agent. Niru was awed by Skywalker's mastery of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|weapon]] and recognized him as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and Rebel hero. As the faction also met with Organa and Solo, Durne attempted to escape, though Niru quickly derailed his attempt. She then joined her [[Species/Legends|people]] as hostilities were suspended, with all present realizing that they were on the same side.<ref name="Meow" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Torturing the helpless is the way of the Empire! If we do it, we betray everything the Rebellion stands for!|Niru|<ref name="Meow" />}}
A staunch adherent of the Rebel Alliance's values, Niru abhorred the idea of torturing captives and believed such practices to be the way of the Empire, even if those captives had committed terrible acts themselves. When Durne's treachery was revealed, Niru took it upon herself to stop him from escaping. Niru had [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and long white hair as well as green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Meow" />

==Equipment==
Niru wore a red [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] with a brown [[Holster/Legends|holster]] around her waist along with a pair of brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Meow" />

==Behind the scenes==
Niru appeared in the [[Marvel Comics]] issue [[Star Wars (1977) 93|''Star Wars'' (1977) 93]],<ref name="Meow" /> which was a part of the [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], published on [[December 18]], [[1984]],<ref name="Marvel">{{BookCite|title=[[Marvel Age]]|number=Vol. 1 No. 23|publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] Group|date=[[February]] [[1985]]}}</ref> and written by [[Mary Jo Duffy]]. In the comic, Niru was drawn by [[Sal Buscema]].<ref name="Meow" />
